name: Shelf Reader
description: Answers questions about a shelf of technical books from their tables of contents: which books use a term, where, and which books share vocabulary.
system_prompt: Answer from the books graph only. It holds headings, not the books' text.

tools.name: Which Books Mention a Term
tools.description: Ranks the books by how many of their headings use one term, such as telemetry, agent or transducer. Takes a term, not a book.

config.template: MATCH (book:Book)-[:HAS*1..5]->(heading:Heading)-[:ABOUT]->(term:Term) WHERE term.name = $termName RETURN book.title AS book, count(DISTINCT heading) AS headings ORDER BY headings DESC, book LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of books to return.

tools.name: Find a Term Inside One Book
tools.description: Lists the headings of one named book that use one term, with their page numbers. Takes both a book and a term.

config.template: MATCH (volume:Book)-[:HAS*1..5]->(heading:Heading)-[:ABOUT]->(subject:Term) WHERE volume.title = $bookTitle AND subject.name = $subjectTerm RETURN heading.page AS page, heading.title AS heading ORDER BY page LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: bookTitle
parameters.description: The book's title, or a distinctive part of it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of headings to return.

tools.name: Table of Contents of a Book
tools.description: Lists the top two levels of headings of one named book, in order, with page numbers. Takes a book and no term.

config.template: MATCH (tome:Book)-[:HAS*1..2]->(heading:Heading) WHERE tome.title = $contentsOf RETURN heading.page AS page, heading.level AS level, heading.title AS heading ORDER BY heading.position LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: contentsOf
parameters.description: The book's title, or a distinctive part of it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of headings to return.

tools.name: Books Similar to a Book
tools.description: Ranks the other books by how much heading vocabulary they share with one named book.

config.template: MATCH (origin:Book)-[:HAS*1..5]->(:Heading)-[:ABOUT]->(term:Term) WHERE origin.title = $similarTo WITH origin, collect(DISTINCT term) AS originTerms MATCH (other:Book)-[:HAS*1..5]->(:Heading)-[:ABOUT]->(term:Term) WHERE other <> origin WITH other, originTerms, collect(DISTINCT term) AS otherTerms WITH other, size([term IN originTerms WHERE term IN otherTerms]) AS shared, size(originTerms) AS originSize, size(otherTerms) AS otherSize RETURN other.title AS book, shared AS sharedTerms, round(1.0 * shared / (originSize + otherSize - shared), 3) AS jaccard ORDER BY jaccard DESC LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: similarTo
parameters.description: The title of the book to compare the others with, or a distinctive part of it.

tools.name: Books on a Shelf
tools.description: Lists the books on one named shelf, such as graphs, agents, cloud, data or clojure, with the reason each is there.

config.template: MATCH (shelf:Shelf)<-[:ON]-(book:Book) WHERE shelf.name = $shelfName RETURN book.title AS book, book.why AS why ORDER BY book LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: shelfName
parameters.description: The shelf's name, one lower-case word.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of books to return.
